**C.** The ordinance is content-neutral and aimed at keeping the park clean, not at suppressing communication. Under *O'Brien*, even if dumping the trash counts as symbolic speech, the government may regulate it incidentally when the rule serves an important interest unrelated to suppressing expression and burdens speech no more than necessary. Choice D is wrong because conduct can be communicative, and A and B fail because symbolic speech isn't immune from neutral regulation and *Brandenburg* is irrelevant.

CONFIDENCE: 90
